entries.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one original painted bitmap technology icon for the Victoria 3 mod 1776 - Age of Revolutions, technology 'Road Engineering / Génie routier'. Primary request: communicate engineered road construction and levelling, NOT a photograph-like patch of finished paving stones. Subject: a substantial period wooden A-frame plumb level, warm worn oak, with clearly joined triangular members and one horizontal crossbar. A thin cord hangs perfectly vertically from the apex, carrying a distinct dark brass plumb bob aligned with the central mark of the crossbar. This levelling instrument is the dominant recognizable silhouette. The only supporting element is a compact physical cutaway specimen of an engineered roadbed immediately below and slightly in front of the level: ochre earth beneath tightly hand-packed pale stones on edge, a middle layer of smaller grey angular stones, then a thin fine-gravel top layer with a gently crowned profile and simple drainage shoulder. Readable continuous three-layer construction, not several scattered stone piles. Show the cut face prominently, not a broad top-down finished road. The two objects form one compact coherent still life with credible geometry and unobscured plumb bob. Style/medium: painterly volumetric historical strategy game invention icon, stylized material realism matching Victoria 3 native technology art; hand-painted edge accents, identifiable wood grain and stone, soft restrained highlights, natural material colours, not a flat PM pictogram, not glossy 3D, not uniformly sepia. Framing: square canvas, centered three-quarter view, strong compact silhouette clearly readable at 48 and 64 pixels, complete objects with generous transparent margins. Lighting: soft upper-left illumination and short self-shadowing on the objects only. Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent alpha around the complete object group and through every gap in the wooden frame, including around the hanging cord; no black, white, grey or checkerboard backdrop. Constraints: exactly one icon, no labels, no text or letters or digits, no logos or watermark, no frame or medallion, no embedded interface, no unrelated tools, no separate paper plan, no person, no building, no landscape scene, no modern asphalt or road markings, no steamroller or modern instrument, no raised paving blocks dominating the composition. This is a conceptual illustration inspired by historical road levelling and layered stone foundations, not an asserted exact reproduction of a dated museum object.
entries.concept: Dominant wooden A-frame plumb level with layered crowned roadbed cutaway; no finished paving patch or landscape.
